mentions.name: AllZonefiles.io
mentions.description: Platform offering daily domain lists, DNS zone files, and historical domain data, aiming to be the most useful platform for domain and web data. Recently achieved full coverage for five ccTLD zones (.se, .nu, .li, .ee, .ch) with more ccTLDs in progress, and includes continent filtering for ccTLDs, a coverage filter, country flags, and growth charts for every zone.
mentions.audience: Projects needing domain lists for cybersecurity, brand monitoring, SEO, internet research, and expired-domain hunting
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building AllZonefiles.io for the past two years - daily domain lists, zone files, and historical domain data. Trying to make it the most useful platform for domain and web data.
mentions.author: iryndin
